# Emails

Every transactional email. Same contract as notifications: one that is not declared does not exist, and both of its message keys resolve in every locale.

**Nothing sends any of these yet either.** There is no mail transport in this tree, and `catalog/emails.toml` marks the single entry below as the one that exists to prove the mechanism — the entry a later stage replaces.

## `catalog.mechanism`

Parameters: none

| | Key | en | pt-BR |
|---|---|---|---|
| Subject | `email.catalog.mechanism.subject` | Noctua is working | O Noctua está funcionando |
| Body | `email.catalog.mechanism.body` | This message exists so that Noctua can check its own email reaches you correctly. Nothing is expected of you. | Esta mensagem existe para o Noctua conferir que o próprio e-mail chega até você corretamente. Nada é esperado de você. |
